description: Returns EV charging stations near an Icelandic town or lat/lon from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0) with sockets, kW output, and operators. Live occupancy is marked unavailable where operators lack open APIs.

fast_only.description: Only return fast chargers >= 50 kW (default false).

name: get_ev_chargers
title: Get EV Charging Stations in Iceland
